internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Founded in 1988, Kenneth Hardware Stores evolved into one of the largest and mostly equipped hardware superstores on the Maltese islands. KHS currently operates from a modern seven hundred square meters three storey building located in the heart of Zabbar. The Company supplies a vast range of hardware products to retailers and wholesalers,households as well as to small, medium and large private, public and govenmental organisations.
